title: Oracle: OD-18 rules BL-19 — -h/--help after a subcommand stays the dispatcher's
body:
Oracle ruling on the logged evidence `BL-19` (with `BL-5`), dispatched by the unattended delivery driver on base `run/web`.

**OD-18** — after a subcommand name, `-h`/`--help` stays the **dispatcher's**; a subcommand parser never advertises it. This ratifies the LOW default the steward proceeded on in `docs/plans/oracle/subcommand-flag-forwarding.md` (OD-10/`R1006`), so that plan stands as written.

No requirement is added and none superseded: the ruling settles who owns a flag, not what the system must do.

Handoff: `docs/oracle/handoff-2026-08-20-6.md`.

Opened by the server-side `open-pr` workflow at the driver's request (ESC-50).
